- Previous experience in both payroll and purchase ledger.
- Working knowledge of Sage Line 200 and Sage Payroll (advantageous but not essential).
- A proactive, flexible, and hands-on approach to work.

- Excellent communication skills and high attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities within a small, busy team.
